authentication: Contemporaneous public direct GET checks without Cookie or Authorization. Actual logged-in browser parity is not proven.
title: Uploader playlist v1 has a 500-items-per-GET boundary and accepts paging
claim: In a public uploader with reported totalCount 1082, the default v1 playlist user-uploaded request returns 500 items. PageSize=500 with pages 1/2/3 returns 500/500/82, giving 1082 unique IDs in registeredAt-descending order; pageSize=501 or 1000 returns HTTP 400.
unconfirmed: Request size boundary is observed for one public uploader and cannot establish a universal API maximum or all-client behavior.
No authenticated browser CORS test or rate-limit stress test.
Total counts during concurrent uploads, huge counts, or other listing categories require separate checks.
The source is a sanitized contemporaneous probe transcript, not the raw HTTP response body.
integration_status: isolated research branch; requires maintainer review before merging/publishing
